reviews.body:
I ran this on current main (3cb403051) and on main with this diff applied (python venv, no real backend).

Main reproduces the bug. I built real `openai` `ChatCompletion` and `ChatCompletionChunk` objects with a tool call and `finish_reason: "stop"`. On main both paths return `stop_reason: end_turn` next to a `tool_use` block. This PR returns `tool_use` in both.

What I checked on the PR (non-streaming and streaming, real openai types):
- tool call plus `stop`: `tool_use` (main: `end_turn`)
- `tool_calls`: `tool_use`, unchanged
- text only plus `stop`: `end_turn`, unchanged
- tool call plus `length`: `max_tokens`, unchanged
- tool call plus `content_filter` (non-streaming): `end_turn`, unchanged
- text block, then tool block, then `stop`: `tool_use`, blocks still 0 text and 1 tool_use
- two tool calls then `stop`: `tool_use`
- `stop` in the same chunk as the tool call, and `stop` followed by a usage-only chunk: `tool_use`

Tests. `test_anthropic_translation.py` passes (102 passed). If I copy the PR's test file onto main, the 2 `tool_use` tests fail and the 3 "unchanged" tests pass, which matches the description. `tests/unit/providers/utils/inference` goes from 271 passed on main to 276 passed on the PR. In this venv 3 files fail to collect on both main and the PR (`test_anthropic_mixin.py` needs the `anthropic` package, plus `test_embedding_validation.py` and `test_transformers_inference.py`), so they were not run.

Limits, none of them blocking. If a backend sends tool calls and never sends any `finish_reason`, the streamed `stop_reason` is still `end_turn`, as on main (I ran it). I did not run the `/v1/messages` HTTP route or a real Gemini endpoint. That `stop` is what Gemini sends comes from the linked forum report, which I did not check.

Approving.
